subject: AI-Forward — pack source (pack/) + live dogfood install (.claude/, .github/, docs/)

surfaces.documentationPortalSections: 12 — Getting Started, Capabilities, Skills, Multi-Agent Collaboration, Agent Coordination, The Prompt Loop, Context Budget, Foundations, UI & Design, Architecture, Systems, Graph, Reference

diagramFamilies.note: The four families live in architecture.md rather than a docs/diagrams/ split: they are part of that document's linear read, so splitting them would duplicate a source rather than separate a lookup surface (the LOA Part IV test).

coverage.publicSurface: pack/scripts/*.py — the bundle deployed to consuming repos as docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/. tools/* is repo-local build tooling and is deliberately out of surface.
coverage.coverageGapPolicy: A public function with no docstring is emitted as a recorded gap in docs/api/, never as fabricated prose.

confidence.apiReference: Verified — extracted by tools/build-api-docs.py with ast from the modules' own docstrings and argparse definitions; drift-gated by check-consistency.py.
confidence.diagrams: Verified — every node/edge re-traced to tools/sync-pack.ps1 and the directory layout on 2026-09-03; two stale claims corrected (see architecture.md).
confidence.cliReference: Verified — traced to each script's argparse definition.
confidence.coverageNumbers: Verified — computed from the source, not asserted.
confidence.explainerContent: Verified — true to pack/knowledge and pack/commands.
confidence.contextBudgetFigures: Verified — the portal's Context Budget section reads its baseline, tolerance, backstop and tier totals from pack/context-budget.json and the docs' own load: frontmatter at build time, so the published numbers cannot drift from the CI gate that enforces them.

gate.timeBased: .github/workflows/docs.yml (weekly; V13 review-by decay, V16 flags, orphans)
gate.hookOption: Not used. .git/hooks is not versioned, so a hook cannot be relied on across clones or in CI.

knownGaps: 60% of public functions in pack/scripts/ carry no docstring. Each is listed individually in its module's docs/api/ page under Coverage. This is the largest open documentation debt and is recorded rather than fabricated.
pack/scripts/docs-explorer-core.js has no generated API page: the extractor is Python-only (ast). Its behaviour is covered by tests/docs_explorer/docs_explorer_core.test.js.
tools/*.py and tools/*.ps1 have no generated reference by design — repo-local build tooling, not part of the deployed surface. They are documented in architecture.md's CLI table.
